shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && ls src 2>/dev/null; ls app pages 2>/dev/null; cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | head -30

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && grep -rl "proxy.ts\|middleware.ts" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js | head; grep -o "MIDDLEWARE_FILENAME = [^;]*\|PROXY_FILENAME = [^;]*" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | head -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

(npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- / ---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/"; echo "--- /about ---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/about | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/"; echo "--- server log ---"; cat /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next dev" || true
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short
